content.introduction: Global stock markets fluctuated with mixed performances, driven by geopolitical tensions and economic indicators. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq experienced volatility, while international markets showed varied trends influenced by U.S.-Iran relations. Current data reflects ongoing market dynamics and investor sentiment.
body: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close lower as chip stock rebound fails. Sean ConlonTue, Jun 9th 2026. S&P 500 closes higher as chips stage a comeback, Iran stops strikes on Israel. Asia-Pacific markets trade higher as investors assess U.S.-Iran peace deal diplomacy. Asia markets trade mixed as oil eases after Trump delays planned Iran strike. European markets rebound after Trump threatens Iran. European markets end higher as Iran's peace talks stall, defense stocks slide. European stocks close higher as Iran war concerns weigh on sentiment. European stocks close lower as Trump considers Iran peace proposal, UAE leaves OPEC. European markets close lower as Iran reportedly makes peace proposal. European stocks lower as U.S.-Iran ceasefire deadline looms. European stocks end near flat as UK GDP jumps and Iran peace talks remain in focus. European markets close lower as Iran peace hopes fade. Asia markets trade lower as oil surges after U.S. moves to blockade Iran ports.

## Global Markets News. The dollar looks ready to break higher. Here's why Wall Street is turning bullish. July has been a slam dunk month for the Nasdaq-100. But traders may have front-run it this time. This rocket stock is testing a key level once again. Why Todd Gordon thinks it's a buy. Some rising market risks to watch out for in the second half. Oil prices edge higher as US-Iran peace talks continue. Asian shares gain post US tech rally, yen steady. Markets should beware 'pain trade' shocks in the second half: HSBC. Wall Street sees more gains ahead for this SpaceX supplier. Citi Wealth warns investors to move out of excess cash because of hot inflation. Morgan Stanley cuts oil forecasts on faster-than-expected flows via Strait of Hormuz.
